listing.title: TIED RIBBONS Handmade Red Crochet Flower Bouquet
listing.description: A handmade artificial flower bouquet featuring five crochet blooms, decorative leaves, red paper wrapping and ribbon detailing. Made with wool and paper components, this maintenance-free arrangement is designed for desks, shelves, living spaces and gifting. The flowers do not require watering, sunlight or trimming. The package contains one red crochet bouquet.
listing.careInstructions: No watering, sunlight, trimming or daily plant care is required. Keep dry and remove surface dust gently when needed.
listing.returnConditions: Returns or exchanges are accepted within 10 days of delivery under the standard Hastabazaar return policy.

excludedConflict: The separate source product-description section describes a different yellow flower-pot product and was not used.
